title: Create an ML pipeline with Amazon SageMaker Pipelines [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this hands-on tutorial on Amazon SageMaker Pipelines.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到 Amazon SageMaker Pipelines 實作。

cues.en: In this tutorial, indeed, we're gonna build a machine learning pipeline using Amazon SageMaker Pipeline, which is a serverless workflow orchestration service
cues.zh: 這堂建立機器學習管線，使用專門為 MLOps 與 LLMOps 自動化設計的

cues.en: purpose-built for MLOps and LLMOps automation.
cues.zh: 無伺服器工作流程協調服務。

cues.en: So it's pretty cool what we're gonna do.
You can easily build, execute, and monitor repeatable end-to-end ML workflows with an intuitive drag and drop.
cues.zh: 直覺拖放，輕鬆建置、執行、監控可重複的端到端 ML 流程。

cues.en: You will see it's super easy to build a pipeline UI or the Python SDK.
cues.zh: 可用管線 UI 或 Python SDK。

cues.en: So we will actually do the drag and drop.
Amazon SageMaker Pipelines can scale to run tens of thousands of concurrent ML workflows in production.
cues.zh: 正式環境可擴展到數萬個同時執行的 ML 工作流程。

cues.en: All right, are you excited? I'm very excited.
I really love using SageMaker Pipelines to build machine learning pipelines.
cues.zh: 很喜歡用它建機器學習管線。

cues.en: You will see it's super easy.
All right, so let's go to Amazon SageMaker AI, inside which I already created a domain, you know, to prepare everything.
cues.zh: 進 SageMaker AI，我已建網域準備好。

cues.en: We already use SageMaker many times already in this course, so no need to do the whole domain creation again, and besides, I would rather recommend only watching
cues.zh: 課程已用過很多次，不重做；也建議先觀看，

cues.en: this tutorial because you know that SageMaker is quite an expensive service.
cues.zh: 因為 SageMaker 費用不低。

cues.en: However, if you are doing the tutorial, make sure to not forget to do the cleanup at the end, as we did many times already in this course.
cues.zh: 若跟著做，別忘最後清理，之前做過很多次。

cues.en: we're gonna launch, not Canvas, but the Studio, because SageMaker Pipelines is actually a feature of SageMaker Studio.
cues.zh: 不是 Canvas，是 Studio，因為 Pipelines 在 Studio。

cues.en: Okay? Not Canvas.
Important to remember that. There we go.
Welcome to the SageMaker Studio, and you will find the Pipelines feature right here, as you can see, to build automated ML workflows.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到 Studio，Pipelines 在這裡，用於自動化 ML 流程。

cues.en: All right, so let's click Pipelines, and now, of course, we're gonna click Create in Visual Editor to build this machine learning pipeline using drag and drop.
cues.zh: 按 Pipelines，再 Create in Visual Editor，以拖放建立管線。

cues.en: All right, and now you will see it's super easy, super user-friendly.
We're basically gonna redo the whole machine learning process, or, you know, machine learning pipeline that we did in all the previous sections, you know, including data preparation,
cues.zh: 基本上重做前幾節全部機器學習流程，包括資料準備、

cues.en: model development, model deployment, and even the fine tuning in just a few clicks.
cues.zh: 模型開發、部署，甚至微調，只需幾次點選。

cues.en: Okay? So, of course, I'm just gonna show you the steps.
We're not gonna rebuild and retrain and redeploy everything.
cues.zh: 不真的重建、重訓、重部署。

cues.en: Otherwise, it would take ages, but still, you will see that with just a few clicks, just a few drag and drops, well, we can rebuild the whole machine learning pipeline for whatever data we have,
cues.zh: 否則很久，但幾次拖放，就能為任何資料、

You can either choose to bring your own container or use a prebuilt container.
You specify the container framework, like for example PyTorch, which is the best for AI today.
